items.description: Recovery of stolen bicycle incl. locksmith call-out and cutting seized lock (3 pcs)
items.rationale: Recovery costs fall under 5.2.2(a)/(b), and each required attendance counts in its own right. The bike is unscheduled mobility equipment, so the EUR 500 aggregate sub-limit (4.2.2) covers recovery and repair together. Assumed fair total: ~300 recovery + ~500 repair + ~100 labour = ~900, scaled by 500/900 to ~167 for this line.

items.description: Repair of theft damage to bicycle (frame and brakes, 2 pcs)
items.rationale: Damage found on a recovered item is made good under 2.3.1(b) and 7.1.1(b). It shares the EUR 500 mobility sub-limit rateably with the other lines. Assumed fair price ~500, giving ~278.
Labour and sundries serving the covered repair are part of the repair cost (7.1.7(d),(e)), but the allocation is somewhat unclear. Assumed fair price ~100, scaled under the EUR 500 sub-limit to ~56.
